stem: What is one reason this song has endured for so many years?

options.label: A
options.text: The song was inspired by religious revivals.

options.label: B
options.text: The song celebrates a patriotic act from the past.

options.label: C
options.text: The song is about protecting the rights of people.

options.label: D
options.text: The song was a theme for civil rights activism.

visual_elements: Francis Scott Key wrote a poem titled “The Defence of Fort McHenry” during the War of 1812.
The poem was combined with music and became a popular song known as “The Star-Spangled Banner.”
“The Star-Spangled Banner” was adopted as the national anthem of the United States in 1931.
